name: bdf_get_oat_yield
description:
France's 10-year government bond (OAT) yield in percent, monthly average: the ECB's long-term interest rate for convergence purposes, series IRS.M.FR.L.L40.CI.0000.EUR.N.Z. The ECB publishes no other French maturity, so bond_term accepts only 10y.
Returns: series_code (ECB flow.key), series_id, label, unit, unit_multiplier, frequency, source, observation_count and observations (date, value) oldest first; a note when the period has no observations.
Inputs (none required): bond_term (10y; default 10y); start_date, end_date (YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM or YYYY); recent_periods (1-100; default 10; the last N observations, used only when neither date is given).
For euro area AAA yields by maturity use ecb_get_bond_yield.
Example: {"bond_term": "10y", "recent_periods": 12}
